# ERD Online

> The Git + Figma for database design: versioned ER diagrams, diffs, and live collaboration.

Human start (no login): https://www.erdonline.com/demo

## Docs

- What it is: https://doc.erdonline.com/docs/guide/what-is-erd-online/
- MCP for Cursor (secondary; same projectJSON, not ChatSQL): https://doc.erdonline.com/docs/guide/api-and-mcp/
- English MCP: https://doc.erdonline.com/en/docs/guide/api-and-mcp/

mcp.json uses `npx -y --package <GitHub Release tarball> erd-mcp` plus `ERD_PAT`. Demo share is not a PAT. Self-host: `ERD_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9502`.
